scenarios.prompt: The user is meeting former college friends for a long Sunday lunch at a casual modern restaurant and wants to look noticeably more considered without appearing overdressed. Build around the required textured oversized shirt, control its volume while seated, and create meaningful alternatives rather than swapping bottoms mechanically. Do not invent shoes or accessories.

weather_context.condition: mostly indoor lunch with a short sunny walk

scenarios.prompt: Style the required grey joggers for an overnight train, an early station arrival, and four hours of sightseeing before hotel check-in. Balance sleep comfort, air-conditioned carriage temperatures, secure practical layering, and looking presentable in daytime photos. Use the windcheater only if its color and function improve the outfit; do not assume unlisted footwear.
